back: A measure of how responsive quantity supplied is to a change in price.
% change in quantity supplied ÷ % change in price.

front: Is PES normally positive or negative?
back: Positive: price and quantity supplied move in the same direction.

front: Which straight-line supply curves have PES = 1?
back: Any straight line through the origin.

front: Supply curve when PES is infinite?

back: Time; spare capacity; stocks; ease of switching factors (and length of the production period, perishability).

front: Why is farm supply inelastic in the short run?
back: Crops and livestock take a long time to produce, and many farm goods are perishable.

front: Why does inelastic supply cause large price swings?
back: Quantity cannot respond much to a change in demand or weather, so the price changes a lot instead.
